mapper.select: SELECT emp23_etc_leave_person_id AS etcLeavePersonId , emp23_etc_leave_id AS etcLeaveId , emp23_person_id AS personId , f_get_emptrans(emp23_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS orgName , f_emp_kor_nm(emp23_person_id) AS personName FROM emp23_etc_leave_person , emp22_etc_leave , emp01_person , emp03_trans , org00_org_info WHERE emp23_etc_leave_id = #{etcLeaveId} AND emp22_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp22_etc_leave_id = emp23_etc_leave_id AND emp23_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate()) AND emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date ) ORDER BY org00_org_cd, f_org_seq(org00_org_code_id, emp03_trans_date, emp01_company_id), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd)

SELECT emp23_etc_leave_person_id AS etcLeavePersonId , emp23_etc_leave_id AS etcLeaveId , emp23_person_id AS personId , f_get_emptrans(emp23_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS orgName , f_emp_kor_nm(emp23_person_id) AS personName FROM emp23_etc_leave_person INNER JOIN emp22_etc_leave ON emp22_etc_leave_id = emp23_etc_leave_id WHERE emp23_etc_leave_person_id = #{etcLeavePersonId} AND emp22_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM emp23_etc_leave_person WHERE emp23_etc_leave_id IN (SELECT emp22_etc_leave_id FROM emp22_etc_leave WHERE emp22_company_id = #{companyId}) AND emp23_etc_leave_person_id IN #{etcLeavePersonId}
